mhnxeditor SD card test file
============================

If you can read this on the console, the SD card is mounted and both the libnx
fs API and newlib stdio can reach it.

Copy this folder to the root of your SD card so that the path becomes:

    /switch/mhnxeditor/hello.txt

Then launch dist/mhnxeditor.nro from hbmenu and press A to probe again.
